title: Staff RFIC Design Engineer
desc:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, and software technologies into solutions that help drive advancements in digitized factories, mobility, and digital healthcare, combat climate change, and reliably connect humans and the world. With revenue of more than $9 billion in FY24 and approximately 24,000 people globally, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible™. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and Twitter (X).
Position Overview
Analog Devices is looking for an intelligent and versatile
Staff RFIC Design Engineer
to work with our
RF Semiconductors
team, based in
Istanbul, Turkey
. This role will drive product developments such as
RF Beamformers, Up-Down Converters, Mixers, Detectors, Switches, Attenuators, Filters, Phase Shifters, Amplifiers
for various markets, and will take a lead role in solving complex technical problems and guiding technical direction across projects.
Context on the role
As a Staff RFIC Design Engineer, you will operate as a key technical contributor in a complex and critical environment. You’ll lead problem resolution with significant latitude, anticipate change, and redirect efforts as needed. You’ll act as a resource for colleagues with less experience by mentoring and providing technical direction, and you’ll influence effectively across and up/down the organization.
Job Duties
Integrated circuit design at transistor level for RF blocks
Technical leadership on ambiguous or high-impact design challenges, including defining approach, tradeoffs, and success criteria
Design evaluation and silicon bring-up, including first-silicon characterization, root-cause analysis, and driving corrective iterations
Design and development for RF products across various process and packaging technologies
Development of methods and solutions, contributing to improved design approaches, models, or workflows where appropriate
Project and cross-functional leadership, including clear technical communication to enable alignment across organizational lines
Documentation and communication, producing required reports and communicating results and recommendations clearly
Mentorship, guiding the technical growth and professional behaviors of lower-level engineers through coaching and technical direction
Requirements
M.S. Degree in Electrical Engineering (PhD preferred) or equivalent
Typically requires 7+ years relevant experience
Solid understanding of S-parameters, transmission line theory, and RF networks
Demonstrated ability to innovate, design, simulate, and verify circuit performance at transistor level and behavioral/architectural level, with strong RF fundamentals
Experience in circuit design environments such as Cadence and ADS
Skills in electromagnetic simulators such as EMPro and/or HFSS (plus)
Demonstrated IC tape-out experience is needed
Experience with test equipment and RF characterization (plus)
Strong technical judgment and ability to develop resolutions to complex problems involving in-depth analysis and variable factors
Motivated, results-oriented, and organized, with strong writing, presentation, and communication skills
Willingness and ability to learn new topics quickly, take calculated risks, and operate effectively with ambiguity
Ability to influence and promote teamwork and technical excellence within and beyond the immediate organization
Why you will like working at ADI
We place great value on individual judgment.
We allow our employees the freedom to explore new ideas and the autonomy to determine how to best achieve business goals and objectives.
We emphasize professional development and mentoring.
Above all, we recognize that the personal goals of our employees and the company’s goals are closely related and must support each other.
